title: rinorea longipes
intro: Rinorea longipes, commonly known as the "Kadukkai" plant, is a climbing shrub native to the tropical regions of Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional Indian and Ayurvedic medicine, where it is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Rinorea longipes include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, rheumatism, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other polyphenols, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties.
